mapping_policy: Exact per-file mapping from the frozen package. source_ref and old_path define provenance; content_policy defines whether the body is frozen, navigation-only, refreshed current content, or a tag-extracted historical copy.
additional_updated_entrypoints: other active Skill/example/task_env/doc links affected by these exact path moves

historical_resolution.frozen_originals: Interpret Markdown links and source paths from source_ref + old_path; do not rewrite original bytes to make current links appear local.
historical_resolution.json_provenance: Retain source paths, hashes, authorization and counts as facts about their source_ref; use this mapping to locate relocated files.
historical_resolution.broken_historical_links: Report separately from active current-link errors; do not change frozen verdicts to eliminate a historical break.

protected_local_input.policy: preserve untracked local input at original path; do not migrate or commit

raw_workspace_evidence: Ignored outputs, H5, stdout, zip archives, local USD and source asset bundles remain outside docs and source distribution.

additional_local_inputs.policy: preserve untracked local input in F and integration worktrees
